Text: Conte a Rada o que aconteceu no caminho para Babylon.
Diga que está bem e que vai explorar por conta própria.
Diga que está procurando os Sverd Mercenaries, não a Tower.
Sabe onde estão os Sverd Mercenaries?
Pergunte por que ele está chorando.
I was looking for Ingel and the mercenaries.
Why don't you give them to her yourself?
I'm on my way to the Bardad Expedition Garrison.
I guess since I'm going that way anyway...
I hope you get to see him.
(Relay what happened at the Sunshade Encampment.)
Do you know anything about the Sverd Mercenaries?
Seems they were the Shadow Wolves.
Did you find out anything about the mercenaries?
I wonder where the Sverd Mercenaries are.
Anything I can do to help in the meantime?
You hand over the operational orders.
You relay what the Strike Captain said.
I don’t mind. I’ll meet him.
You fill out the paper and hand it back to Jehan.
Does that mean I can't pass?
You hand over the rejuvenation potion.
I’m looking for a man named Symon.
You relay the details of the search.
Continue to listen to her story.
This is the work of a master.
Relay the news as Kamiya requested.
There is someone I must save.
I know a Naruru who can help.
I have a favor to ask.
I think he means young Narurus have gone missing.
It looks like a secret correspondence.
You ask how the festival proceeds.
You ask what is being cooked.
What kind of dish is it?
You ask if Azran sent him.
You force a smile on your face.
Is it because of the Incursions?
I am looking for the Incursion Specialist.
Speak to Mitchell, who is lost in thought.
What if I explain the situation?
Simon lost his life to the Wolves…
As long as everyone is safe.
I’ve known him for a long time.
Make a motion as if tightening the grip on the weapon.
Looks like the Paradise Advent Society robes.
Did you not see him at the Giant’s Tower?
We must stop them from hurting people.
Beretta asked me to put the meal on her tab.
I’m looking for the Paradise Advent Society.
What do you know about the Paradise Advent Society?
Ask about how to go up.
Tell me how to go up.
Now I want to go even less…
…Sounds more like a threat than a request.
You reply that you’re just coming back from the tower.
I'm here to pay the debt.
Doesn't look like a beast did this.
I'll check it out and return.
It seems quite close to the Gate Guard.
That would be best for safety.
...I still want to find Ingel first.
If they used a phase shifter…
I have a bad feeling about this, but fine.
You must head to the Starfall Plateau.
I know it’s east of here.
You mean use the tower’s power?
I have other things to do first.
The tool... You mean the tower?
You wonder what situation they were in when observed.
You explain what happened at the manor.
You hand over Stormkell Archon’s letter of recommendation.
Have you seen any Paradise Advent followers?
You deliver the deserter's gift and regards.
Did you happen to see any Paradise Advent followers around?
I’d at least like to know the direction...
What kind of person is Astrid?
Know anything about the Paradise Advent Society?
What do you plan to do?
You report what you saw on the stronghold and hand over the secret letter.
Purpose unknown, but they seem to be cooperating.
You explain what happened with Astrid.
Remember who gave it to you?
You describe the appearance of the Paradise Advent.
Did you see the Paradise Advent?
Just that the Paradise Advent came and left.
I heard you were looking for me.
What on earth is going on?
I know how to make the antidote.
There was a way to heal without killing.
You’re not happy of handling things this way.
What do you need them for?
You explain what happened at the Sanctuary.
You hand over what was requested.
I don’t have time to waste.
You explain what you know about the Incursion.
I’m just a mercenary without ties to any nation.
Hard to believe, but it’s the truth.
You deliver Gale’s report and extend the request.
I’ll decide after I hear it.
I can't ignore the will to live.
No, that’s why I want the Paradise Advent gone.
Let’s finish up and head to the Sanctum.
We must stop it... But how?
You... What on earth are you?
We must go to the Divines. Now.
Is it because of Gudua, or whatever it is?
I just need to reach the Warden.
I was just finishing up anyway.
Must have hidden out of sheer terror.
We need to find Mucha's sister first.
Mucha is crying and looking for you.
Know anything about artifacts related to the Tower?
Like something that opens a hidden space…
I need to find it, no matter what…
As long as you're safe, that's what matters.
We're looking for traces of the dragon from the old tales.
Will the Evil Dragon really be there?
Doesn't seem to be in this area.
I'm looking for the Horn of Dawn.
You… you are the Paradise Advent Society!
It’s fine as long as you’re fine.
Are you sure you have no interest in the Tahn Kingdom?
I just did what I was supposed to.
Do we need the Manors’ help as well?
We can stop by the forest on the way.
Something is off about her reaction.
Do you know anything about this jar?
He got hurt badly trying to protect me.
We are just south of the Elysium…
You tell her about the conversation with the Warden.
You explain what happened at the citadel.
Has the fog in their minds cleared?
I don't know where she went either.
If you keep moving, the poison will spread…
It could be the Paradise Advent Society.
Don't push yourself. Leave this to me.
Has she completely lost her mind?
You try your best to explain the situation.
Did you get close to the Horn of Dawn?
Why are you pushing yourself so hard?
Hearing you say that only makes me more curious.
What are you planning to make with the Golems?
So what needs to be done?
...What are you making me do this time?
Not a chance for that amount of coin.
You don't need to give me any.
Tell me how I can help.
I'm here because it looks like you could use some help.
Hand over the paper with the cipher on it.
What kind of work is it?
That doesn't seem like a good fit.
If you don't have combat experience, it might be...
I'm curious why you'd think that.
Is this a request from Azran?
Wouldn't it be better to start with surveillance?
I'm looking for an opportunity to learn from a master hunter.
I came on behalf of the Naruru.
It looks like it could fetch a decent price.
Why do you need the leather?
I'll discuss it with my colleague.
Look back and forth between Muina and Azran.
Hand over the document from Azran.
Tell me more about this artifact.
There's nothing but wasteland and cliffs out here.
Fill me in on the situation.
I need to work, but I barely have any strength left.
Then the White Lion family's revenge...
It had no effect on the monsters.
What do you stand to gain?
A village chief should be wise.
You listen closely to Ramasu's words.
You point out that their equipment looks worn out.
You say there's a way to get them directly.
Just take it back from the Kuduru.
You tell him to hold on.
Say that they look incredibly busy.
But we still need operating funds...
Point out that they look extremely worried.
Mention that it's a shame the experience was so short.
Offer to gather some for them.
The first human he trusted? What do you mean?
Ask if he is all right.
Tell him not to blame himself.
Recommend focusing on the thrilling sense of freedom.
You think you’re the boss here?
How do I get up there?
Add the braces, glue, and feathers.
I have a place to go.
I-It’s because of the rare herb.
It's safe to come out now.
So this is why it's a Mountaineering Club...
Doesn't the general store sell ingredients too?
They seem pretty reliable when it comes to trading.
Can't you just buy them from the store next door?
Nina from the restaurant across the street made it.
I will lend you my strength.
I think you're better than me.
Straight to the errands without warning…
You should get out more and move.
I was summoned to Babylon quite often.
If it helps, I don't mind.
Could it be because of the Thunderbird?
Is it because of the monsters in the tower?
The flowers are already in bloom.
Or was there a reason to look for God?
Is it okay if it stings?
Why did you leave it there?
Are you sure you've looked around enough?
Do I just need to fix the bridge?
Just tell him you're a mercenary.
What exactly is this legend anyway...?
So why aren't you doing it?
Who exactly is this person you like...?
I took care of the monsters for you, so spit it out.
What kind of job do you have for me?
Sure, I'll give it a shot.
Why do you look for a campsite?
...What does that have to do with me?
Of course. Just leave it to me.
Why didn’t you request all of them at once?
So you don’t like them being cautious?
Why tell me if it’s a secret?
No. I'm sick of hunting competitions.
Brought some ingredients. It’s a gift.
…What kind of mess did you make?
That’s unfortunate. Good luck finding it.
That would be the fault of the one who lost it.
What made you decide to do that?
Let me know if you need anything else.
A mercenary doesn't pick and choose their assignments.
You don't know where it is.
You nod with a determined expression.
You look at them in bewilderment.
Why is a Stormkell soldier here...?
You stare with a puzzled expression.
You planned to make me do it from the start...
I have a favor to ask as well.
I wanted to help from the beginning.
What is the preservative used for?
If it's something I can do.
I only did as I was told.
Tell me who your liege is.
You hand over the monster blood and poison fang.
You look at them in bewilderment.
I don't think I can join you.
I was just looking around to see if there were any contracts…
…Your personality is just as foul as before.
I can’t believe you still haven’t accepted the results.
I have to go somewhere else for water…
I’ll be the judge, so stop it.
You finally saw what I’m capable of, right?
I’m not a recruit… I think.
I'm darn good at hunting beasts.
What’s your relationship with Guild Master Kian?
Defeat as many as you can?
Didn’t you say that you are a farmer?
You must have a lot on your hands.
Do you want me to find an Incursion?
The ones outside are more aggressive.
What about the Appraisers Guild or Bardad Expedition?
Do you mean Uran, the Romantic Hunter?
Then what about in the afternoon?
A child can go up that high?
I heard dragons are long gone.
There are a lot of rare monsters nearby.
Are you talking about the Ashen Crows?
If we can retrieve it quickly…
You should return to your hometown…
I'll have them ready by the exit.
Protecting the Naruru… Are you a Bristly-Hair?
Explain past interactions with the Naruru.
What if you speak for me?
When it comes to speed, I'm confident.
I can help you with the monsters.
Hard to wrap your head around it, isn't it?
You believe in the Naruru god?
,,,And here I thought it was something serious.
I was reaching my team through the communicator, and…
I should be asking you the same thing.
...I told her my name, despite the lingering suspicion.
Flowers? You need flowers? Why would you...?
What do I need to find?
What do I need to find?
You can give it to me here.
I'll take that as a compliment.
I haven't even seen her lately...
Fine. I'm in a rush, so let's be quick.
You both survived. That’s all that matters.
Doesn't it mean... to bring it down?
If that happens, everyone will perish.
Does that involve stopping the Tower and protecting the stars?
So there’s a second and third as well?
I didn't even realize you were tailing me.
Even my shadow will haunt them.
I plan to stay for a few days.
All right, I'll show you how it's done.
Let's take it back and dry it properly.
Make an excuse that a friend is waiting.
Quaista told me to find you.
The mission to track the Shadow Wolves...
I've already killed them, so it's too late.
They didn't tell me the location.
I heard it was burnt to the ground?
If there's nothing else, I'll be on my way.
How exactly did you contact my communicator?
...You want me to just start working right away?
That's because I've searched for it before...
I'll escort you to the Training Ground.
What kind of power are you talking about?
Why don't you just stay here?
Do not jump to conclusions so carelessly.
You must really like the Naruru.
We have our own secret code.
Why are you curious about that?
We used it often in the mercenary group.
I want to look at it alone.
I will meet Dabin and Kamiya first.
I want to look at it alone.
You pause for a minute, then nod.
What do you mean they were collected?
I have a favor to ask.
I am looking for the Snowfield Mage.
By any chance, do you know the Snowfield Mage?
I'll go, even if I have to go alone.
I didn't do it on purpose.
Aren't you here for the Tower's power?
What are you planning to do now?
What are you planning to do now?
Why are you telling me so belatedly?
No, but thanks for the help.
Are you the new recruit who lost their weapon?
What kind of abilities do they possess?
I have... that kind of power?
You understand the gist of it.
A man who looked like the king...
(You reply that every detail has been recorded.)
I'm looking for the Appraisers’ Guild.
They all seem to be the same person...
I want to know about the Monolith.
Why are you chasing remnants of the ancient empire?
How many Liberators of Knowledge are there?
I might not be a part of it.
I think I can find it.
The one who was assigned the role?
They claimed to be the administrator.
They didn’t seem to be tricking me.
It was full of idle chatter.
Rada! Please let it slide just this once.
Could Beretta's hideout be in Babylon?
I don't see anything else but people.
I do feel a faint aura.
What do you mean, make proper contact?
I just felt dizzy for a moment.
Excuse me? Are you saying that right to my face?
Just send them straight to the 2nd floor of the Tower.
…to pass the test and think reasonably.
Sign it and hand it over.
Don't we need the fragments of ruins as well?
The request you mentioned. It can’t be...
All right, let's give it a shot.
You explain why you came all this way.
Ask where Cyril and Ozkan are.
I wanted to talk to you because you looked troubled.
I've helped them out a few times.
Why are you looking for that?
Did you ask your so-called Liberator friend?
I would like to borrow a book, if you don't mind.
Tell them to take their time and think it over.
What do you mean it's the only copy in the world?
Calm down and take a deep breath.
You're quite aggressive for someone who claims to be shy...
I actually got a gold coin.
Let me know if you need help.
I just said it as if I'd actually been there.
What do you mean... already dead?
If it's not a human body, how do we wake them up?
Prophecy? Do you mean the one from the Paradise Advent Society?
Were you looking for information about the Ark?
I sense a vast amount of Aether in that being.
I just have some questions about Tan...
A playwright from a country called... Bellamor?
It turned into an ember-choke grove?
I've heard a lot about it, but...
Wait for them to calm down.
What does the Dragonslayer's sword ornament look like?
Isn't it similar to the Spirit Lake?
Why would they go that far?
Say you'll look around elsewhere first.
Ask if another problem has arisen.
You ask how to pull him out of the ocean.
I was trying to depict the Naruru tribe...
There are others who ran away besides Maureen...
I'm looking for someone named Rene.
Tell them that Fabrice is looking for them.
You sent a letter to Fabrice saying Rene has no intention of returning at the moment...
Let's ask the ranch owner for permission.
You received a reply from Fabrice while Rene was busy with their creative work.
You say that you are looking for “Priya.”
You reply that you’ll go instead.

You built a small stall with Priya,
and displayed wonderful metal crafts.
The floor is a total mess.
It already made a mess of the headquarters.
Are you in need of a commission?
Didn't you call him your brother?
You explain what happened with Armia.
Why would you give me something so important...?
You fail to reach the Appraisers’ Guild in the end.
Is there any way to appease her?
She says to do better next time.
I'm not buying anything, and I'm not a believer.
What do I need to do?
I'm not a member, but I am looking for them.
I'll try talking sense into them...
How do you plan to do that?
Do you know any other hunters?
We need to find those two as well.
I've never heard of a Romantic Hunter.
Let's go on a romantic hunt instead.
Every day is a new experience.
Briefly explain the task performed for Kanber.
I’ve joined one and am active.
But I’ve already joined another clan...
I want to learn about the clan.
I just brought what was given to me...
...Didn’t you just tell me to bring it?
I’m looking for a certain courier.
You should be the one to go.
Why didn’t you transport it yourself?
Why have you come looking for us?
Could I obtain information in return?
Explain that you were sent by Orica.
Hand them the Research Consent Form.
Got it. Just hurry up and get to safety.
Ask him how Nicola's batch turned out.
How do you make it work?
You wonder why it’s not working.
I was about to ask you the same thing.
Care to explain what's going on here…?
So... am I free to go now?
You stare at her in surprise.
It definitely would have been impossible alone.
…Only a massive reward will make me feel better.
What kind of investigation is this...?
It could just be the Trial Gates.
....All right. I'll give it a try.
Then feel free to keep at it yourself.
You put on a nervous look.
I suppose... I am affiliated with it.
You don't look like a Royal Guard...
Explain how you ended up here.
Should I go fishing or something?
I heard results are all that matter...
As long as you pay me, I don't care. What should I do first?
Is there something else to do?
Hand over the clothes and medicine.
Let's make them one by one.
Don't try to boss me around.
In exchange, you have to give me the clothes.
I said I would help, didn’t it?
Didn't you say it was an urgent situation?
This is what I saw earlier...
Wouldn't it be better to go straight underground?
I don't know where to go first.
I want to decorate the Rappie.
I want to decorate the base.
Hmm, some kind of secret mission?
Is this Object the subject of the research?
Isn't this a bit easy for a secret mission?
What happened to the crack in the back?
The one I saw has already vanished.
In the blink of an eye...
Karadu! Do you happen to know the situation?
Was the Brigade Commander attacked too?
The Mali Mercenaries are in pursuit.
Wouldn't it be faster to look around for it?
How was Eyvind when he was here?
Even corpses evaporated. How can there be traces...?
To use our hard-earned Object on a Giant...
If the Object was used to clear the Incursion...
So, it has come to this…
You look at them in bewilderment.
